tonight.headline: 126.44 to 74.54, and Nacua and Kyren Williams need 52 between them tonight
body: Bad news first. Carnell Tate caught one of five targets for 1.6 two days after back tightness; nothing says he re-aggravated it, and Matthew Golden scored 20.3 on your bench. Loveland scored 3.9 and Brenton Strange, swapped out for him, 13.8. The Jaguars' defence scored 3 and the Ravens', the one it replaced, scored 7, so that stream closes WRONG. Barkley has no date.

You are finished at 126.44. Kings of the North have 74.54 and two players left: Puka Nacua and Kyren Williams, projected 39.6 together, need 51.9. ESPN gives you 74%. Neither appears on the Rams' reported injury list. Nothing you hold can change it.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Nacua and Williams combine for 52 or more: roughly a two-touchdown night each. The Rams are favoured at home with a 54.5 total (DraftKings via SI, 7 Oct, and it may have moved).

case.label: Their availability
case.body: Neither is on the part of the Rams' report that could be read (Bleacher Nation, 12 Oct), which covers 4 of 12 listed players. Probably active, not confirmed until 16:45 Mexico City.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Either of them inactive makes it all but certain. Nothing on your side can move.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · Bleacher Nation · SI

whatWentWrong.title: The coin flip at receiver lost by 18.7
whatWentWrong.lead: Tate 1.6, Golden 20.3. Tate was active and no exit was reported.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Tate: 1 catch on 5 targets for 6 (live archive). He had no catch in the first half and a long third-quarter catch was called back for holding (Titansized, 15:55 ET), so he was still on the field after half-time. Golden: 6 catches on 7 targets for 123 and a two-point conversion.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: No card. The projection had it 13.6 to 12.8 and the brief took the projection without a thesis, as the rule says. It is recorded as a miss and not as a reason to start Golden next week on this box score.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A snap count showing Tate was limited by the back. Then it was an availability miss, and the question for Week 6 becomes his practice report.

whatWentWrong.sources: Week 5 live archive · Titansized · AP · NBC Sports

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end seat lost again
whatWentWrong.lead: Loveland 3.9, Strange 13.8. The swap was yours on Wednesday, against the brief's order, and its thesis closes WRONG.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Loveland drew 5 targets from Tyson Bagent, who was benched for Case Keenum. Strange caught 7 of 8 for 68, a second straight game with eight targets (archive: 3, 2, 5, 8, 8).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing tonight. The seat has changed hands three times in five days and stays closed until 14 Oct. Strange is on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00, Jacksonville are off in Week 7, and Caleb Williams is 'on track' to throw to Loveland at Atlanta.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuesday's brief, the last before claims: Strange is a claim only if Williams is not starting and the Week 6 projection puts Strange more than two points clear. You are last in the order, so the claim costs nothing and loses to anyone.

whatWentWrong.sources: Week 1–5 archives · packers.com · AP · Bleacher Report

case.label: The news

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 13 targets in four games, 3, 1, 5 and 4, for 4.3, 0.0, 7.0 and 8.2 (archive). This morning he was a free agent; once the games began he went onto waivers, where you are tenth of ten. Your bench is Barkley, Rice, Golden, and two backs protected by a team-mate's injury: there is no seat.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday. A claim costs you nothing, because you cannot fall lower than last, but it loses to any rival's. If he clears on Wednesday he is free, and the drop is named then.

doNotChase.lead: Jeanty played. Washington had one carry.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Ashton Jeanty was questionable with an ankle and foot injury, which is why managers added his backup.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Jeanty was active and carried 10 times (NBC Sports, 15:41 UTC; PatsFans). Washington: 1 carry and 1 catch, 2.0 (live archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jeanty ruled out for several weeks. Nothing today points that way.

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Eight targets again, a sixth receiver here, and off next week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 6 catches on 8 targets and a carry: 12.1 (live archive). Targets 8, 5, 10, 5, 8. No reporting on his role was found today.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Miami are on bye in Week 6, and he projects below Wilson, Tate, Pickens and Golden every week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second straight game of eight or more after the bye.

doNotChase.name: Jacoby Brissett
doNotChase.lead: Scored 22.8 trailing in Detroit, and Arizona traded their top receiver away the same afternoon.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Detroit had allowed the most points to quarterbacks through Week 4 and the total was the week's highest.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: Live archive: 22.8. Marvin Harrison Jr. was traded to Houston on Sunday (CBS, 11 Oct). No post-game recap of the Lions game was found. You start Lawrence, who scored 20.7.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.6 projected against the 18.0 Lawrence had, and Lawrence scored 20.7. Marvin Harrison Jr. was a healthy scratch and is now a Texan.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next week it is asked again from the projections.

doNotChase.name: Mark Andrews
doNotChase.lead: Played with Huntley throwing: 4 catches on 6 targets, 4.8. Lamar Jackson's ankle has no timeline.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The steadiest targets of the free tight ends, 6, 7, 5, 6 (archive), a full practice week and no designation.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: Live archive: 4.8. Lamar was ruled out Friday with an ankle sprain from Week 4, left in a boot, no timeline (NBC Sports Boston, 9 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Jackson is out with an ankle sprain and Huntley starts (baltimoreravens.com, 9 Oct; Yahoo, 11 Oct). 9.6 projected for a seat that is closed until 14 Oct.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson's return together with Tuesday's projections.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eight names clear the tool's bar, measured against Barkley and Rice, an injury and a bye. Four weeks of data. Sunday answered five of them downward; Coleman plays tonight. None is a move: you are last in the order and no seat is open.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A committee: final line 6 carries and 4 targets for 5.9, Hampton 14 carries for 4.9, Vidal 8 carries for 12.6 (live archive). Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — three backs split it; last week's lead in touches did not repeat

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson was healthy and carried 17 times; Brian Robinson had 7 carries for 16 (live archive). His 25.7 in Week 4 was three touchdowns.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: Green Bay's lead back while Josh Jacobs is on the commissioner's exempt list: 10 carries and both touchdowns today, the team's first rushing scores of the season (packers.com). 31 yards on those carries. You dropped him for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — the lead role is real; today's points were two short touchdowns

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty was active and carried 10 times; Washington had one carry (NBC Sports; live archive).
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: the starter played

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Dislocated his left ankle; out 12 to 16 weeks (NFL Network via Roundtable, 6 Oct). The tool prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Xavier Worthy
rising.roleReason: Healthy and full-time, and he led Kansas City in routes in Week 4 with Thornton out and Rice hurt (DraftSharks, 5 Oct). Rice's hamstring is 'relatively minor' and he may return in Week 6 (roundtable.io, 6 Oct). Now a free agent.
rising.action: WATCH — a free agent now, but you hold Rice from the same offence and have no seat

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: His Week 4 jump came after DJ Moore left. Moore is questionable and Coleman himself is on the report with an ankle (Bleacher Nation, 12 Oct). He plays tonight.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out

rising.name: Roman Wilson
rising.roleReason: Left before half-time with a finger injury, reported as a dislocation, after 20 snaps and one target (Steelers Depot, 11 Oct). Pittman's vacancy went to rookie Germie Bernard, 9 targets.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list unless he practises in full on Wednesday

settled.result: All four have now played: Strange 13.8, Andrews 4.8, Loveland 3.9, Hockenson 1.7 (live archive). The order was right; the swap away from it was the loss.

settled.title: Tate over Golden (the projection lineup, 13.6 to 12.8, a coin flip with no thesis)
settled.result: Archive: Tate 1.6 on 5 targets, Golden 20.3. Tate was active and no exit was reported. The coin flip lost by 18.7.

settled.title: 'Start Tuten in the RB slot, not Gordon' (the card from Tuesday to Thursday)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.6, Gordon 14.8. The projection's call lost by 3.2 and the thesis closes WRONG.

settled.title: Loveland for Strange (your swap on Wednesday, both projected 9.7)
settled.result: Archive: Loveland 3.9, Strange 13.8. Closed WRONG by 9.9. The brief's order that morning, Strange first, was the right one; the second move was churn.

settled.title: Week 5 so far: 22.3 points left on the bench
settled.result: Golden for Tate is 18.7 of it and Gordon for Taylor 3.6. Neither came from a brief overriding the projection; both are the projection lineup losing.

settled.title: 'Start Tuten; Barkley is on the bench at 0.0' (since Tuesday)
settled.result: Barkley was inactive in London. The thesis closes RIGHT with nothing to compare.

settled.title: 'Put in the claim for George Pickens' (Wednesday's first card)
settled.result: Week 5: Pickens 28.0 on 13 targets, Downs 7.7 on 6. One of three graded weeks; the entry stays open.

settled.title: Pickens in the flex over Golden (a coin flip that went to the projection, Thursday)
settled.result: Archive: Pickens 28.0, Golden 20.3. It held by 7.7; no thesis was written on it.

settled.title: 'Hockenson: the seat is closed', a watch row (Saturday)
settled.result: KEI returns added him at 22:49 on Saturday, dropping Charbonnet. Your seat was closed either way, so nothing was lost; the row is gone and Charbonnet takes its place on the watch list.

settled.title: 'Rain showers are likely at Green Bay' (Saturday morning, used against Golden)
settled.result: The National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, 75 to 79°F. The morning figure came from a site whose labels and percentages disagreed. The Tate-over-Golden call is the projection's and did not rest on it.

settled.title: 'Ladd McConkey doubtful to play' (Friday afternoon, in the Keaton Mitchell note)
settled.result: He is questionable; the doubtful tag belongs to Trey Lance. The game is also Denver at the Chargers, not the reverse. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share' (Friday afternoon, from the Inquirer)
settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. It matters to your Jaguars defence, and the brief used one source when the team's own was available.

settled.title: 'Barkley is trending out' (beat writers, relayed since Tuesday)
settled.result: Ruled out on Friday and not placed on injured reserve. He was on your bench at 0.0 all week, with Tuten in his slot.
